:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- (initialization(main) -> true).

main :-
    current_prolog_flag(argv, _),
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, Codes),
    ( Codes == end_of_file -> N = 0
    ; parse_int(Codes, N)
    ),
    N >= 0,
    length(Counts, N1),
    N1 is N + 1,
    compute(0, N, Counts),
    print_list(Counts).

compute(I, N, Counts) :- I > N, !, Counts = [].
compute(I, N, [C|Rest]) :-
    I =< N,
    ( I == 0 -> C = 0
    ; H is I // 2,
      nth0(H, PrevList, _)
    ),
    fail.

% Simple DP approach: build list iteratively
compute_all(0, N, Acc, Acc) :- 0 > N, !.
compute_all(I, N, Acc, Out) :-
    I =< N,
    !,
    ( I == 0 -> C = 0
    ; C is (I mod 2) + (I // 2 bits)
    ),
    fail.

print_list([]).
print_list([X]) :- !, format("~w~n", [X]).
print_list([X|Xs]) :- format("~w ", [X]), print_list(Xs).

parse_int(Codes, N) :-
    number_codes(N, Codes).
```

print_list([X|Xs]) :- write(X), write(' '), print_list(Xs).
